more.question: N4
more.good_when: A developer whose change makes one key result better and another worse can always tell from the vision whether to keep it. Today the vision says KR2.1, KR1.1 and KR3.1 come first and that a change is kept only if no key result before the improved one gets worse, but it gives no order among KR1.2, KR2.2 and KR3.2, so a change that speeds up the accounting team's printing (KR1.2) while adding edits to the developers' own code (KR2.2), or lengthening their install (KR3.2), leaves the developer unable to say whether it brings invoicer's users closer to their goals.
